meta.heading: THE TEAM

members.bio: Leading the club since 2023, Arjun oversees all operations and drives the club's vision forward.

members.bio: Priya coordinates between all departments and manages event planning and external competitions.

members.name: Rohan Verma

members.bio: Sneha leads all software and AI/ML initiatives, from firmware to machine learning models.

members.name: Karan Singh
members.bio: Karan leads the AV team, managing video production, editing, and live event coverage.

members.bio: Ananya designs and assembles PCBs, manages component sourcing, and handles all hardware builds.

members.name: Vikram Joshi
members.bio: Vikram specializes in motion control, sensor fusion, and competition robot builds.

members.name: Meera Nair
members.bio: Meera works on club websites, internal tools, and automation scripts.

members.bio: Dev handles camera operations, drone footage, and visual storytelling for all club content.

members.name: Ishaan Kumar
members.bio: Ishaan is the go-to for hardware troubleshooting, wiring, and mechanical assembly.
